# ABLTY

> ABLTY (https://ablty.app) is a web app (PWA) for training and testing psi abilities. It offers structured remote viewing practice with AI-graded scoring, psi tests including Zener ESP cards and presentiment training, and a lucid dreaming toolkit. The name is pronounced "ability," and the tagline is "Every human has the ability."

ABLTY is in early access. Visitors can install the app at https://ablty.app/earlybetaaccess.html.

## What ABLTY offers

- **Remote viewing training**: Protocol-based blind-target sessions where users receive a blind target reference number, record their impressions through sketches and sensory descriptors, and receive AI-graded scoring across multiple dimensions, with accuracy trends tracked across sessions.
- **Psi testing and training**: Research-based protocols including Zener card ESP trials with a clear 20 percent chance baseline and cumulative statistics, plus presentiment and precognition training.
- **Dream Lab**: A lucid dreaming toolkit with timed reality-check prompts, an AI-assisted dream journal that surfaces recurring dream signs, and a wake-back-to-bed timer for lucid dream induction.
- **In development**: A daily community target with global leaderboards, and a structured out-of-body training module.

## Who it is for

People curious about remote viewing, ESP, precognition, lucid dreaming, out-of-body experiences, and parapsychology, whether they are complete beginners or experienced practitioners who want structured protocols, blind targets, statistically honest scoring, and long-term statistics.

## Background

Remote viewing was studied for more than two decades in U.S. government research programs, most famously the CIA's Project Stargate, whose files have since been declassified. ABLTY packages protocol-based training inspired by that research into a modern app with AI grading and long-term statistics.
